notes: Catalogue was empty, so all part types are new; names are descriptive guesses from the Element IDs and pictures.
Colours are estimated from the line art, not read from an inventory page (the inventory pages were not in the supplied pages).
The minifigure (helmet, visor, head, torso, legs) is shown as a separate build in the top box. It is not shown placed in the helicopter, so no edge joins it to the helicopter.

Exact stud-to-stud contacts for the plates, skids and engine pods are inferred from small drawings. In particular: the second skid b16 is attached to plate b10, the engine pod b27 is on plate b11, the side pod b31 is on plate b9, and the tail rotor b30 is on the gun holder b25.
Step 4 sub-assembly: the two 393726 pieces are placed on the two studs of the Technic brick 4233486. Their exact shape is unclear.
In step 6 the pictured model seems to have yellow round pieces on two pods. The parts box lists only one 3005744, so only one is modelled.
The main rotor b29 is mounted on the top stud of plate b23 and is modelled as free to rotate.
The 9551 steering wheel is modelled as one piece standing on the hull base.
